review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer (Cloud & On-Prem)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Security Architecture & Segmentation: Design and maintain deny-by-default segmentation across sites and clouds: zones, VLANs, virtual networks, security groups, and documented data flows. Hybrid Connectivity: Configure and maintain IPsec/IKEv2 site-to-site VPNs with BGP between sites, AWS GovCloud, and commercial AWS, including failover design and testing. Incident Response & Documentation: Take part in incident response and root-cause analysis; maintain architecture diagram
eligibility_evidence: The Role Valar Atomics is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer to own the security of our hybrid infrastructure: the networks and firewalls at our sites, our AWS GovCloud and commercial AWS environments, and our Microsoft Azure commercial and GCC High tenants.
Hybrid Connectivity: Configure and maintain IPsec/IKEv2 site-to-site VPNs with BGP between sites, AWS GovCloud, and commercial AWS, including failover design and testing.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Basic Qualifications 7+ years in network or infrastructure security engineering, including 3+ years securing AWS environments. Expert, hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS (hardware and VM-Series) and GlobalProtect. Hands-on experience with IPsec/IKEv2 site-to-site VPNs and BGP routing. Proficiency with Terraform and at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell, or Bash).
